flipToBack.timing: Required after-trigger on isTableChanged (automatic, singleton). Branches on whether any non-Tatooine location is on table.
flipToBack.prose: If a non-Tatooine location is on table: flip requires you OCCUPY 3 battleground sites AND you occupy at least one battleground site with a non-unique alien of your Rep's species (the species alien may be at any occupied battleground site, not necessarily a distinct third). If NO non-Tatooine location is on table: flip requires you OCCUPY 2 battleground sites. Rep is the unique alien with species revealed at setup (stored in WhileInPlayData; no flip possible if Rep unset).

children.req: branch gate: non-Tatooine location on table
occupiesWith: >=1 battleground site occupied with non-unique alien of Rep's species
children.gameConditions: GameConditions.occupiesWith(game, self, playerId, Filters.battleground_site, SpotOverride.INCLUDE_EXCLUDED_FROM_BATTLE, Filters.and(Filters.non_unique, Filters.alien, Filters.species(rep.getBlueprint().getSpecies())))

children.req: branch gate: non-Tatooine location on table

flipToFront.prose: Flips back if you do NOT occupy 2 battleground sites. NOTE asymmetry: the back never re-checks the species-alien / 3-site branch; 2 occupied battleground sites always suffice to hold the back, even with non-Tatooine locations on table.

requirementSemantics: flipToBack: OCCUPY counts (2 or 3 battleground sites) - occupy, not control; INCLUDE_EXCLUDED_FROM_BATTLE
flipToBack conditional branch: presence of ANY non-Tatooine location on table raises the bar and adds the occupiesWith species-alien leg (occupiesWith without count = at least one such site)
flipToFront: NOT occupy 2 battleground sites - the 3-site/species branch is NOT re-checked on the back
chosen-state: Rep (unique alien whose lore specifies species) chosen from Reserve Deck at setup, stored in WhileInPlayData and as gameState Rep
typedIdentities: Filters.non_Tatooine_location (branch gate; also back forfeit condition via UnlessCondition)
Filters.and(Filters.non_unique, Filters.alien, Filters.species(rep.getBlueprint().getSpecies())) (species actor - dynamic per chosen Rep)
Filters.and(Filters.frozenCaptive, Filters.Han) (frozen Han condition); Filters.Rebel immune to No_Bargain / Bad_Feeling_Have_I
Filters.Jabba, Filters.Bib (back battle-destiny +2 condition); Filters.Wounded_Wookiee (destiny +3); Filters.sameTitle(rep) (drain/destiny cancel cost + deploy-as-if-from-hand)
setupAndPullRoutes: On deploy: deploy Desert Heart and a Jabba's Palace site from Reserve Deck; choose Rep = one unique alien with species from Reserve Deck (revealed, stays in deck; stored as Rep); optionally deploy Well Guarded [src/gemp-swccg-cards/src/main/java/com/gempukku/swccgo/cards/set112/dark/Card112_015.java:54-93]

Remainder of game: copies of your Rep stacked on this objective may deploy as if from hand (MayDeployAsIfFromHandModifier on Filters.and(Filters.stackedOn(self), Filters.your(playerId), Filters.sameTitle(rep))) [src/gemp-swccg-cards/src/main/java/com/gempukku/swccgo/cards/set112/dark/Card112_015.java:137-140]
Back, once per YOUR control phase: RETRIEVE a non-unique alien of Rep's species [src/gemp-swccg-cards/src/main/java/com/gempukku/swccgo/cards/set112/dark/Card112_015_BACK.java:117-140]
otherObligations: Remainder of game: your Rep is a leader; Well Guarded immune to Alter; you may NOT deploy 'insert' cards or operatives [src/gemp-swccg-cards/src/main/java/com/gempukku/swccgo/cards/set112/dark/Card112_015.java:109-121]

Remainder of game: while frozen Han on table, Rebels immune to No Bargain and Bad Feeling Have I (incl. deploy-cost immunity) [src/gemp-swccg-cards/src/main/java/com/gempukku/swccgo/cards/set112/dark/Card112_015.java:122-136]

Back: once per turn may cancel a Force drain OR a just-drawn battle destiny by stacking a copy of Rep from hand on this objective [src/gemp-swccg-cards/src/main/java/com/gempukku/swccgo/cards/set112/dark/Card112_015_BACK.java:65-114]

Back modifiers: your battle destiny draws +2 while Jabba AND Bib on table; Wounded Wookiee destiny +3; your aliens forfeit +2 unless a non-Tatooine location on table [src/gemp-swccg-cards/src/main/java/com/gempukku/swccgo/cards/set112/dark/Card112_015_BACK.java:143-153]
seedMismatches: Seed structures the 3-site branch as OCCUPIES count 3 'byWhom' rep-species alien, conflating two separate checks. Source is: occupies(3, battleground_site) AND separately occupiesWith(battleground_site, rep-species non-unique alien) with no count - the species alien needs to be at only ONE occupied battleground site, and the other two legs need no particular occupier (Card112_015.java:156-157).
